lore.chalk.chalk: A stick of chalk carved from Calcite. Draw marks and arrows on any surface. Can be dyed, and made to glow.
lore.chalk.white_chalk: A stick of chalk carved from Calcite. Draw marks and arrows on any surface. Can be dyed, and made to glow.
lore.chalk.chalk_box: A box that holds several sticks of Chalk. Sneak-use in the air to pick which one you draw with.
